one_line: Persian polymath of the Ghaznavid era, studying Indian sciences and Sanskrit around 1030 CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, slender but resilient scholar’s build
appearance.face: Oval face with a high thoughtful forehead, medium wheatish complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, arched brows over intense, curious eyes; default expression is calm concentration with a slight analytic frown.
appearance.hair: Short, slightly wavy dark brown hair just touching the ears, mostly hidden under a deep blue soft Persian-style turban wrapped low around the head with a subtle tail fold at the back.
appearance.costume: A long, modest Persian-style robe (qamis) reaching the ankles in muted cream wool, worn under a sleeveless, hip-length deep blue woolen overcoat (jubba) with simple brown edging; a wide dark brown leather belt at the waist with a small attached pouch and hanging tassel; full-length loose trousers in soft dull brown under the robe; plain leather ankle boots in dark brown; over his shoulder a light grey woolen shawl draped from left shoulder to right hip, practical and slightly worn; minimal jewellery: a single thin silver ring on the right hand; overall fabrics look sturdy and travel-worn, with no ornate embroidery, just subtle woven texture on the shawl.
appearance.signature: A rolled manuscript of Kitab al-Hind bound with a simple leather tie in his left hand, and a small brass astrolabe hanging from his belt at his right hip.

ref_desc: Al-Biruni is a late-40s Persian scholar with an oval face, short beard, deep blue turban, cream robe, deep blue sleeveless overcoat, brown belt, grey shawl, dark brown boots, carrying a rolled Kitab al-Hind manuscript and a brass astrolabe in a cream, blue, brown, grey and brass palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Al-Biruni: a late-40s Persian polymath with an oval face, high forehead, medium wheatish complexion, sharp nose and neatly trimmed short beard, shown in calm, concentrated expression. His short wavy dark brown hair is mostly covered by a deep blue soft Persian-style turban wrapped low around his head with a modest tail fold at the back. He wears a long cream wool robe reaching the ankles under a sleeveless, hip-length deep blue woolen overcoat with simple brown edging, cinched by a dark brown leather belt that holds a small pouch and a hanging brass astrolabe at his right hip. Loose dull-brown trousers show beneath the robe and tuck into plain dark brown leather ankle boots. A light grey wool shawl is draped diagonally from his left shoulder to his right hip, looking practical and slightly travel-worn. His only jewellery is a thin silver ring on his right hand. In his left hand he carries a rolled manuscript bound with a simple leather tie, representing Kitab al-Hind. Show him in a neutral standing pose, front view, with clear visibility of face, turban, robe layers, belt, shawl, boots, manuscript and astrolabe, using a restrained cream, deep blue, dark brown, light grey and brass colour scheme.
